title: Unilateral perpetual chase: the chasing side loses at the third occurrence
rationale: The rook shuttles a3 and b3, attacking the undefended cannon after every Red move, and the cannon steps aside each time. The cannon never attacks back: capturing down the file would need exactly one screen and there is none. The chase is one-sided, so at the third occurrence the chaser loses — the same shape as a perpetual check and the same rule for naming the loser.
